What is the recommended dosage of bleaching powder for 15,000 m3?

Titles are generated by AI from Meta

Calculation for quantity of Bleaching Powder :-

• Recommended dosage 10 to 15 ppm active chlorine (10 ppm for example)

• 1 ppm = 1 mg/litre of water or 1 gram per tonne of water (10 ppm means 10 g per tonne or m3)

• Example 1 ha pond with 1.5 m water (1 ha= 10,000m2)

• Total volume of water = 10,000 x 1.5 = 15,000 m3

• Quantity of chlorine required = 10 x 15,000 = 150000 g or 150 Kg

• Bleaching powder contains 30-33% chlorine (say 30%), so 1 Kg of bleaching powder contains only 300 g chlorine (0.3 kg)

• So for achieving 150 Kg chlorine , divide 150/0.3 = 500 Kg bleaching powder.
